attributes.name: Smoke Arrows
attributes.powers:
Display this card; you may not do this during an encounter. After doing so, if you have more than 2 cards that have the Ammunition trait displayed, recharge 1 of them.

While displayed, when you play a weapon that has the Bow trait, if you fail a check to defeat a bane and are proficient with weapons, you may discard this card to ignore the result and evade the bane.
